notice: Synthetic corpus. Every name, mark and number is invented; no customer, production or real project bytes (owner decision OD-17).

channel_rules.channels_with_differences: the engine must report a difference in each of these channels
channel_rules.channels_without_differences: the engine must report no difference in any of these channels
channel_rules.unconstrained: a channel in neither list may or may not report; for example a changed number may or may not also show in geometry because its glyph pixels differ

coordinates: PDF points, origin at the lower left of the MediaBox, as written; no sheet in this set has /Rotate or a CropBox. bbox = [x0, y0, x1, y1].
